name: static-web-app
description: Hosting for static frontends (React, Angular, Vue) with integrated API backend

defaultConfig.note: Free tier for most SPAs (2 custom domains, 0.5GB storage, 100GB bandwidth/month). Standard for enterprise features (~$9/month).

integration.identityNote: Static Web Apps use system-assigned managed identity for backend API functions. Frontend is static (no identity needed). API functions can access downstream services.

bicepWiring.note: Static Web Apps can either use built-in Azure Functions (api/ folder) or link to an external backend. For complex backends, link to Container Apps.

connectsTo.description: Static Web Apps frontend calls the backend API via /api/* proxy. Backend can be: (1) built-in Azure Functions in api/ folder, or (2) linked external backend (Container Apps, App Service). For downstream Azure services, use the linked backend's managed identity.
connectsTo.wirePattern:
Frontend (React/Vue) → SWA proxy → Backend API → Downstream services

The frontend calls /api/* which is proxied to the backend. The backend handles auth and connects to Azure services.

frontendPattern.note: Include staticwebapp.config.json for routing rules, auth config, and API runtime selection
